deliverables.train_dpo_pairs_jsonl: chosen reward==1.0 vs lower-reward rejected on same task_id; fields chosen, rejected, reward_chosen, reward_rejected, reward_margin, progress_margin, split=='train'; eval holdout tasks excluded
deliverables.compact_max_tokens: --compact-max-tokens (default None, unchanged defaults/key sets); observation_compactor used when available with validation, built-in tool-only fallback otherwise; assistant messages byte-identical
deliverables.extra_runs_roots: --extra-runs-roots merges cross-model/counterfactual JSONL trajectories (incl. desaturated DPO chosen/rejected unfolding), holdout-filtered, group advantages recomputed
deliverables.trainer_24k_loader: load_rows_within_token_budget / apply_left_obs_first_truncation: 0 assistant tokens truncated at 24576, final pipeline_repair/final_report.json turns never cut
deliverables.dpo_cpu_verification: L=-log sigmoid(beta*((pol_chosen-ref_chosen)-(pol_rejected-ref_rejected))) with exact analytic gradient and finite-difference checks alongside SFT/RLOO/DAPO; dL/dlogp is negative on chosen and positive on rejected, so the descent step is positive on chosen and negative on rejected; loss_mask==0 gradient exactly 0.0
deliverables.bundle_algos: run_offline_rloo_dpo.py --algo awr|rloo|dpo (DPO consumes train_dpo_pairs.jsonl when present); launch_gpu.sh supports CLUSTER_GPUS=4|8 and Qwen2.5-Coder-7B/14B/32B-Instruct
